tidbit: Did you know… about 15,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Parents are suing OpenAI, alleging that GPT-4o coached their daughter off seizure medication. Reported by TechCrunch.
Anthropic's IPO filing outlines major risks from artificial intelligence, including the possibility of sentience and manipulation. Confirmed by Ars Technica.
Researchers are growing frustrated with OpenAI's approach to sharing scientific breakthroughs, which the company limits to selective access. Confirmed by The Verge.
Walmart says its artificial intelligence training program is boosting confidence with the technology among its 2.1 million associates. Confirmed by CNBC.
China released its first artificially intelligent film for theatrical distribution, but the movie flopped at the box office. Confirmed by Fortune.
Free every hour.
